event_census: Exact epoch-bound source records are sorted and deduplicated by provider event identity; identical retransmissions are idempotent and conflicting duplicates invalidate the interval.
futures_sequence_semantics: Kraken documents seq as a subscription-message sequence number but does not document cross-reconnect continuity here. Positive shape and duplicate conflicts are validated; no undocumented global or cross-reconnect increment guarantee is assumed.
spot_trade_id_semantics: Unique per book source-event identity and deduplication key; not a documented lossless connection-level continuity proof.
